title.zh: 基材差异：绝缘优势也有边界
title.en: Substrate differences: insulation benefits have limits

subtitle.zh: 电介质特性、寄生参数与热变形
subtitle.en: Dielectric properties, parasitics and thermal deformation

body.zh: 玻璃本体绝缘，有利于减少衬底导电相关损耗；整条互连电容、损耗和串扰仍须按结构验证。TSV图含RDL、硅衬底和TSV；TGV图含RDL、玻璃基材和TGV。简化寄生电路仅为R（电阻）、C（电容）的概念图；完整链路包含孔、RDL和回流路径，橙色为信号路径，蓝色为回流路径。
body.en: Bulk glass is insulating and can reduce substrate-conduction losses, but complete-link capacitance, loss and crosstalk still require structural verification. TSV and TGV diagrams each label RDL, substrate and via. The R/C parasitic circuit is conceptual. The complete link includes via, RDL and return path; orange marks the signal and blue the return.

body.zh: 架构确定后选择基材，为孔、RDL与封装设计提供材料输入。明确频段和负载 → 确认材料特性 → 提取孔与RDL寄生 → 联合电热评估 → 用测试结构校准。
body.en: Select the substrate after architecture definition to supply material inputs for via, RDL and packaging design. Define frequency/load → confirm material properties → extract via/RDL parasitics → jointly evaluate electrical/thermal behavior → calibrate using test structures.

body.zh: 控制硅电阻率/玻璃介电特性、工作频段、热膨胀系数CTE、基材厚度和平整度。调整玻璃配方改变CTE，也可能改变介电与加工特性，不能分开选择指标。失效包括插入损耗超标、串扰增大、热变形影响接续。
body.en: Control silicon resistivity/glass dielectric properties, frequency, coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE), substrate thickness and flatness. A glass formulation change to modify CTE can also change dielectric and processing properties; these cannot be chosen independently. Failures include excessive insertion loss, crosstalk and thermally distorted connections.

body.zh: 用矢量网络分析仪测链路S参数，结合材料表征与温变形测量校准模型。材料选择改变布线、接地、散热和工艺温度安排。不同玻璃及不同电阻率硅表现不同；玻璃不代表零电容，低损耗也不自动保证更好散热。
body.en: Measure link S-parameters with a vector network analyzer and calibrate using material and thermal-deformation characterization. Material choice changes routing, grounding, heat dissipation and process-temperature planning. Glass types and silicon resistivities differ; glass does not mean zero capacitance, and low electrical loss does not automatically ensure better cooling.
